connector.name: Xcode: MCP Bridge Wrapper for Cursor by SoundBlaster (soundblaster-mcpbridge-wrapper)

connector.provenanceNote: Published from the soundblaster account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
